dressup: Gojou, a quiet boy who makes traditional hina dolls, finds out that Marin, the most popular girl in class, loves cosplay, and starts sewing her costumes.
drifters: As he dies at the Battle of Sekigahara, the samurai Toyohisa is pulled into a fantasy world full of famous warriors from history, fighting on opposite sides of a war.
driftinghome: Two childhood friends playing in their old apartment block before it's demolished suddenly find the building adrift on a vast sea.
dropkickonmydevil: Yurine, a girl into the occult, summons a demon named Jashin-chan, who now lives with her and keeps failing to kill her so she can go home.
drstone: Every human on Earth is turned to stone. Thousands of years later, science genius Senku wakes up and sets out to rebuild civilisation from scratch.
drugstoreinanotherworldt: An overworked office worker is sent to another world with the power to make any medicine, and opens a small pharmacy in a village.
dungeonmeshi: After a dragon eats his sister, Laios and his party head back into the dungeon to save her. Broke and without food, they decide to cook and eat the monsters along the way.
durarara: Mikado moves to Ikebukuro wanting excitement, and finds a city of colour gangs, an info broker, a man who throws vending machines and a headless rider on a black motorbike.
duskmaidenofamnesia: Teiichi meets Yuuko, a beautiful ghost haunting his school who can't remember how she died, and they form a club to investigate the school's ghost stories.
edenoftheeast: Saki meets a naked man with no memory holding a gun and a phone loaded with 8.2 billion yen, and is drawn into a game to change Japan.
edenszero: Shiki, a boy raised by robots on an abandoned amusement park planet, sets out across the galaxy to find the space goddess Mother.
edgerunners: In a city obsessed with body modification, a street kid named David loses everything and becomes an edgerunner, a mercenary who will do anything to survive.
efataleofmemories: Two linked love stories set in a small town, one about a manga artist and a lonely girl, the other about a boy and a girl who can only remember 13 hours at a time.
eightysix: The Republic claims its war is fought by drones, but the machines are really piloted by the Eighty-Six, a persecuted minority. A young officer starts to command their squad by radio.
elfenlied: Lucy, a horned girl with deadly invisible powers, escapes from a lab and is found on a beach by two cousins, with no memory of who she is.
emmaavictorianromance: In Victorian London, a maid named Emma falls in love with William, the son of a wealthy family, despite the gulf between their classes.
encouragementofclimb: Aoi, an indoor girl afraid of heights, is reunited with her childhood friend Hinata, who loves mountain climbing, and slowly starts climbing again.
endoandkobayashilivethel: Prince Sieg starts hearing two gods narrating his life. They're really two high schoolers playing a dating game, and they help him understand his tsundere fiancée.
engagedtotheunidentified: On her 16th birthday, Kobeni learns she's engaged to a boy named Hakuya, who moves in with her family along with his little sister.
engagekiss: Shuu runs a struggling company that fights demons on an artificial island, and powers up through a contract with Kisara, a demon girl.
erased: Satoru keeps jumping back in time just before disasters. When his mother is murdered, he's sent back 18 years to stop the killings of his childhood classmates.
ergoproxy: In a domed city where humans live with androids, investigator Re-l looks into a series of murders tied to a virus making androids self-aware.
erin: Erin, the daughter of a woman who raises war beasts, sets out on her own after her mother is executed, and learns to care for a rare beast called the Ouju.
eromangasensei: Masamune, a teen light novel author, finds out that the illustrator for his books is his little sister, who hasn't left her room in a year.
eurekaseven: Renton, a teenager bored with his life, meets a mysterious girl named Eureka and joins the crew of a rebel airship.
